title: SNAX-FORGE accelerator file
description: <slot>_acc.hjson: a slot's datapath block, what SNAX-GVSoC's standard composite builds the slot's SnaxUnit and SnaxShell from (snax-gvsoc snax/snax_cfg.py, snax/snax_unit_acc.py; snax_forge/gen/gvsoc.py, D134).

inputs.description: The unit's input ports in order, one per streamer reader.

outputs.description: The unit's output ports in order, one per streamer writer.

in_widths.description: Each input's element bits, in inputs' order (D142).

in_signed.description: Whether each input's elements are signed, in inputs' order.

out_signed.description: Whether each output's elements are signed.

config.description: The role of each configuration word; ["count"] when left out.

fields.description: The shell's configuration CSRs in order; start follows them.
